reference_device: Infinix X6870 (INFINIX, Android 16/API 36, arm64-v8a, 4 KB pages, 5.58 GB RAM)

criteria.notes: Pinned 1.19.3 server answered /global/health 200 on the reference device via the bundled musl loader; the isolated harness app did the same in its app sandbox (4.609 s) after verifying the pinned hashes. Airplane-mode and production-app install runs not performed.

Host cold start to healthy 4.572 s; harness app-sandbox server start to health 4.609 s; production app UI cold launch 1756 ms, warm 81 ms. App-sandbox cold/first-run/warm p95 for the production app not measured.

Asset manifest is valid JSON and matches runtime/manifest.json (binary 37c7de...); artifact, executable and archive hashes verified on the host and by the harness installer on the device. Production startup enforcement wired (PinnedRuntimeInstaller + AppRuntime.ensureReady); device smoke test pending.
Harness app executed the loader, PRoot and OpenCode from its native-library directory with zero execute_no_trans denials; 25 MediaTek perf_ioctl denials only. Production-app E2E suite not run.
Reference device uses 4 KB pages; host verify-runtime reports min ELF LOAD alignment 65536 B, and the harness reports 65536 B (loader) / 16384 B (PRoot) on-device. CI ELF-alignment step added.
SSE probe showed heartbeat-only traffic, but the gateway request-counter test is not implemented.
No trace gateway-receive to frame-commit instrumentation in the app.
No Macrobenchmark run; UI bridge not wired to the runtime.
Cancel path is not wired in the app.
500-trial resync simulation passes; reconnect delivers a new server.connected event. Live 500-drop device run not performed.
100,000-case traversal/noncanonical-path safety run passed on the reference device JVM.
300/1000 SIGKILL atomic-write stress runs passed on the reference device JVM; app-sandbox SIGKILL run and the remaining runs are pending.
Stale-precondition conflicts are rejected (E_CONFLICT path); external-change-between-open-and-save UI flow not exercised.
Bounded reads of a sparse 1 GiB file pass; first-screen latency and peak memory thresholds not measured.
All 60 file/folder create/rename/move/trash/restore cases passed on the reference device JVM.
Only the git API module exists; no git service implementation to validate.
MainActivity passes ptyService=null; terminal UI is not wired to a PTY service.
Production terminal service is absent. Harness forkpty cleanup with --kill-on-exit passed, but signal handling in the production terminal cannot be exercised.
Production terminal service is absent. Harness native PTY reported 80x24 and environment parity, but production resize behaviour cannot be exercised.
Flood behaviour cannot be exercised until the terminal service is wired.

Scripted native-PTY byte round trip passed in the harness app for text, Enter (CR->LF via ICRNL), Backspace, Tab, Esc, Up, Ctrl-C and Alt-x. Physical Gboard mapping and the production terminal UI remain untested.
Rotation during a streamed reply is not testable with the runtime offline.
Agent task/background survival requires the app runtime to be wired.
Host supervisor restart/health-timeout/crash-loop tests pass; on-device 50 SIGKILL restarts pass (50/50 healthy, p95 4,132 ms, sessionsLost=0).

Canonical zero-interaction 10-min run: stop-after-idle passes (stoppedAfterIdle=true, postStopTicks=0) but idle server process-tree CPU averages 3.458% of one core vs the 1.0% threshold (max 12.58%). Per-thread idle investigation queued.
Post-G0 4 h soak is deferred as a post-v1 optional check per the G3 gate.
30 min thermal soak is deferred as a post-v1 optional check per the G3 gate.

Health, doc, project, session, PTY and event routes return 401 without the secret and 200 with Basic auth on the host; the harness app also reached authenticated /global/health from its sandbox. A second-UID instrumented client was not run.
Host scan: no secret patterns, no execute_no_trans denials (25 vendor perf_ioctl only). On-device scan (spike quick): 0 credential findings, 3/3 denied paths enforced, no extra APK entries.
Release manifest invariants (debuggable false, one exported launcher, permission allow-list, no global cleartext) are enforced in CI and passed.
Permission prompts and transcript visibility require the runtime/UI wiring.
Pinned hashes, CycloneDX SBOM and license-artifact checks are green. osv-scanner and the GPL source offer are not present.
Remote-profile TLS validation is a v1.1 item; not required for v1 G3.
No two-build diffoscope comparison in CI.
No upgrade/install documentation or downgrade-refusal test.
No release signing configuration or apksigner verification step.
Nightly contract-drift workflow is green, and the live /doc capture is byte-identical to the pinned OpenAPI contract.
39 targeted core tests pass on the reference device JVM; 80% coverage and zero-lint thresholds are not measured.
No nightly device E2E workflow.
